name: Mercenary On the Prowl
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of On the Prowl (players/ranger/mercenary/on_the_prowl_merc.sval, 12 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 5 (in brackets): evasion 15% (25%). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Casting a skill gives 25% movement speed and 15% evasion for 4.5 s.
